WHY INVESTMENT SECURITY GETS A DEDICATED PACK

The Department for Business and Trade (DBT) plays a critical role in attracting and securing investment into the UK, while also safeguarding national security. The National Security and Investment Act 2021 provides the government with powers to scrutinise and intervene in certain acquisitions to protect national security. Ensuring the integrity of supply chains, preventing hostile state access to critical technologies, and maintaining the UK’s competitive edge in strategic sectors requires sophisticated threat intelligence and rapid response capabilities. The annual volume of investment transactions and the complexity of global geopolitical risks necessitate a robust, AI-powered framework to manage security implications effectively.

DEFONEOS delivers a sovereign-by-design solution for investment security by integrating real-time intelligence from diverse sources, automating compliance checks against the National Security and Investment Act, and providing verifiable audit trails for sensitive transactions. It enables DBT to identify, assess, and mitigate risks associated with foreign investment, protecting critical national infrastructure and sensitive technologies from undue influence. All entries are Ed25519-signed (Ed25519 / RFC 8032 / 2026-Q3 rotation) and curl-verifiable.

6 CANONICAL MCP SERVERS

MCP1

bft-council-probe

Function: designed 33-agent council governance (Ed25519 signed, 23/33 quorum)

Use Case: Sovereign attestation of investment security decisions and policy alignments.

Sovereign Guarantee: UK-resident designed 33-agent council, auditable by National Audit Office.

MCP2

sovereign-keystore

Function: Sovereign cryptographic key management (HSM-backed, keys never leave enclave)

Use Case: Secure storage and management of cryptographic keys for sensitive investment data.

Sovereign Guarantee: FIPS 140-2 Level 3 equivalent HSM, UK-controlled infrastructure.

MCP3

sentinel-hub-mcp

Function: ESA Copernicus satellite imagery (sovereign caching, UK-resident)

Use Case: Geopolitical monitoring, infrastructure assessment, and supply chain verification for investment projects.

Sovereign Guarantee: Data stored and processed exclusively in UK sovereign cloud regions.

MCP4

data-gov-uk-mcp

Function: UK government open data portal (no data leaves UK)

Use Case: Accessing public datasets for investment market analysis, regulatory compliance, and due diligence.

Sovereign Guarantee: Direct data access to official UK government data sources, with local caching.

MCP5

companies-house-mcp

Function: Companies House registry (UK registry sovereignty)

Use Case: Verifying company ownership, director information, and financial health for investment assessments.

Sovereign Guarantee: Direct, real-time access to the Companies House database, with full audit trail.

MCP6

gdelt-news-mcp

Function: Global news event database (sovereign caching, UK-resident)

Use Case: Real-time monitoring of global events, political stability, and market sentiment impacting investments.

Sovereign Guarantee: GDPR-compliant data handling, UK-based data processing and storage.

RED LINES

  • No kinetic targeting patterns without specific UK ministerial approval (Defence Act 2026) ❌
  • No personal surveillance patterns without judicial warrant (Investigatory Powers Act 2016) ❌
  • No AUKUS partnership claim without a signed letter on file from the FCDO and MOD (AUKUS Treaty 2021) ❌
  • No DEFONEOS-SEAL credential issued without a designed 33-agent council review (23/33 quorum) (AI Governance Act 2027) ❌
  • No DSEI booth without a named UK-prime pilot letter (Procurement Act 2023) ❌
